title: review follow-ups of PR #37809: related-list bulk delete still reports counts only; view-declared delete bulk action unmeasured
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR; the first item is a named location) · Source: fleet (PR #37809 body, "Not in this PR", adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37809 (Fixes #37758) makes the list's built-in bulk Delete say why records were refused. Each distinct reason gets one line, led by the names of the records it refused. Two neighbours were left:

- [ ] **The related list's bulk delete** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `bulkDeleteOutcome`) has the same count-only shape: a user deleting rows from a related list on a record page sees only how many failed. Expected: the same grouped reasons, reusing `refusalSummary`'s rule from `ui/packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts`, with a pin and a CONTROL batch that has no reasons.
- [ ] **A view-declared `operation: 'delete'` bulk action** (the "also seen" of #37758) has not been measured. Expected: measure it on `main`. If it reports counts only, give it the same fix. If it goes through `recordDelete`, say so here and close this item.

Category ①: the same user-visible gap on two neighbouring surfaces.
Priority: p3. The list surface, the common one, is fixed. These are the remaining paths.
Business reason: a user whose related-list delete is refused cannot tell which records were refused or why.
Reader: the ux list/record/shell area (seat 2, s2-ux-L).
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37809"` and `bulkDeleteOutcome`: 0 hits.
Related: #37758, PR #37809.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (first item) / unmeasured (second item) → p3
